contracts.beforeEOF: Authenticated independent Node TLS1.3/AES128GCM/ALPNcontinuum-c1 client verifies fixture CA/hostname and receives the exact challenge-bound echo before transport destruction. C pre-EOF probe must allow the narrow quiescent profile with no outstanding retry. IGNORE_UNEXPECTED_EOF and quiet shutdown remain disabled.
contracts.transport: The client calls TLSSocket.destroy without TLS end/SSL_shutdown only after exact echo receipt. Destroy alone does not guarantee FIN: the relay must actually observe its frontend end event, and the pinned server must report unexpected EOF. RST, retry or clean TLS close does not satisfy this test. The relay has two TCP legs; its frontend FIN observation is not a claim of end-to-end migration.
contracts.fatalRead: C waits bounded POLLIN/HUP readiness and performs one actual SSL_read_ex. Raw return0, SSL_ERROR_SSL1, first error-queue librarySSL/reason294 and application amount0 are required. invoke clears the queue before I/O and classifies with SSL_get_error before other OpenSSL calls. ERR_peek_error then inspects the same first entry; later fatal-alert BIO failures can append secondary errors and are not printed.
contracts.refusal: Two metadata-only snapshots after the fatal read must be identical and refused, with last READ2/outcomeERROR4 and no prior retry in this one-call fixture. Existing ledger semantics are unchanged; a terminal error does not generally clear a prior retry. No further read/write/control/handshake/shutdown TLS I/O occurs after fatal SSL_ERROR_SSL; only metadata observation and resource cleanup follow.
contracts.observedMetadata: Author and independent cases observed refusal2052=LEDGER4+HANDSHAKE2048, no retry and shutdown0; public pending0. Independent directional next sequences1/2 and2/3 are metadata observations only. Fatal handling can emit its own alert; those counters are not independently wire-accepted in this scenario.
contracts.wire: wire=null, fixtureGracefulShutdown=false. Exact echo receipt and actual client-side transport FIN are checked, but no full bidirectional capture oracle, server FIN, graceful TLS closure or post-fatal sequence acceptance is claimed. The fatal SSL_read implementation may internally emit an alert and advance output sequence; this is not a later application TLS call.
contracts.unchanged: Probe/header/patch/build/oracle and generic invoke ledger semantics, application/capture caps, native NGINX/history/LICENSE are unchanged. Existing18 flat tests are preserved.
